analysis_metadata.analysis_scope: Current workspace re-evaluation after refactoring sprint

major_refactors_validated: Access control domain split into RolesService, PermissionOverridesService, AccessVerificationService
Organizations domain split into OrganizationsService, MembershipsService, InvitationsService
Role update permissions mutation uses batched deleteMany and createMany
JWT and org-scoped checks implemented in chat gateway
Global request payload validation via I18nValidationPipe

critical.title: Organization invite endpoint lacks explicit permission guard and service-side caller authorization
critical.impact: Any authenticated user may invite users into organizations they should not administer

critical.title: Organization reject-request endpoint lacks explicit permission guard and service-side caller authorization
Membership access-control role assignment path checks membership only, not owner/admin policy
critical.impact: Privilege escalation inside tenant by non-admin members

critical.title: Membership override creation path checks membership only, not owner/admin policy

high.title: JWT secret uses fallback literal when env is absent at constant evaluation
high.impact: Token forgery risk in misconfigured deployments

high.title: Chat gateway CORS allows all origins with credentials
high.impact: Expanded attack surface for socket abuse and token replay contexts

high.title: Invitation status casing mismatch between creation and acceptance logic
high.impact: Legitimate invites may fail to be accepted

high.title: Chat conversation creation validates users, not tenant membership for all participants
high.impact: Cross-tenant data bleed risk through conversation linkage

medium.title: Invite DTO roleId is string validated, not UUID validated
medium.impact: Input quality degradation and avoidable runtime lookup errors

medium.title: TypeScript config allows non-strict patterns (noImplicitAny false)
medium.impact: Type safety gaps can reach runtime

medium.title: Coverage remains below production-grade baseline
medium.impact: Increased regression and hidden edge-case risk

speed_and_performance.justification: Major transaction and batch-update fixes are in place, and service decomposition helps tuning. Remaining risk is mostly query policy consistency and some chat/org validation overhead.

security.justification: Core auth exists, but several high-impact authorization gaps are still present in organization and membership access-control mutations. JWT fallback secret and open socket CORS further reduce launch confidence.

readability_clean_code.justification: The God Object split significantly improved cohesion and local reasoning. Inconsistencies in policy enforcement and some status/naming mismatches still hurt reliability.

enterprise_scalability_multi_tenancy.justification: Eventing, Redis adapter, and tenant-aware checks are good foundations. Tenant and admin authorization is not uniformly enforced across all entry points yet.

error_handling_resilience.justification: Global exception handling and validation are correctly wired, but business-logic inconsistencies can still produce high-impact failures not covered by generic error wrappers.

production_readiness.estimated_hardening_time: 2-4 engineering days for blocker fixes and regression validation

items: Apply ownership or permission guard to invite and reject routes
Enforce caller authorization in invitations and memberships services
Restrict membership access-control mutation routes to owner/admin permissions
Remove JWT fallback secret and fail startup when secret missing
Restrict WebSocket CORS origins to trusted frontend URL(s)
Enforce org membership for all chat participants on conversation creation
Normalize invitation status values across services
Tighten Invite DTO roleId to UUID validation
Raise branch coverage for auth, permissions, organizations mutation flows
